        c += matrix[r[-1]][depot]

                # split edges: (a,b) and (route[k],route[k+1]) replaced by (a,route[k]) and (route[k+1],b)
                c = route[k]
                d = route[k + 1] if k + 1 < m else None
                if d is None:
                    continue
                new = base
                new -= dab
                new -= matrix[c][d]
                new += matrix[a][c]
                new += matrix[d][b]

                    route[i + 1 : k + 1] = reversed(route[i + 1 : k + 1])
                    return True
        return False

            ld_to += demands[x]

            delta = matrix[depot][cnode] + matrix[cnode][depot]

        cur = matrix[depot][to_route[0]]

        cur += matrix[to_route[-1]][depot]

        # try positions between nodes (including ends)
        # insert before to_route[0]
        prev = depot

            best_delta = delta
            best_pos = m

        return (best_pos, best_delta)
